function.name: find_image_duplicates
function.description: Scan only user-authorized local image paths, read-only. Group byte-identical or decoded-pixel-identical images. Never delete, modify, or upload images. Requires a local host to execute the bundled JSON adapter.

paths.description: Explicitly selected local directories or image files within host-authorized roots.

mode.description: exact compares raw SHA-256; pixels compares all decoded frames and requires Pillow.

output_dir.description: A NEW absolute report subdirectory under the host-approved report root.

recursive.description: Whether to include subdirectories. Normally true.

include_hidden.description: Include hidden entries only when requested. Normally false.
